name: PT Leyand International Tbk
summary: PT Leyand International Tbk engages in the power plant, electrical machinery, and gas and liquid petroleum gas industries. The firm is involved in trading of oil, kerosene, diesel, and as a gas distributor. It operates through Electricity Sales and Genset Rent segments. Its services include industrial consulting, energy sector consulting, and oil and natural gas field consulting. The company was founded on June 7, 1990 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
